Answer ID: 46627 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1205/300/TB=9/1434) It indicates that you will be blessed with religious life and the love of the Prophet (صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم).
